function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regular expression. Output lines are `path:line:hash|text` so they can be used directly as `edit` anchors. Respects .gitignore.

path.description: File or directory to search, relative to root. Default: whole project.

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, e.g. `*.rs` or `src/**/*.ts`.

context.description: Context lines around each match, 0-3. Default 1.
